$comment: v2 Phase N1 built-in tool-adjacency defaults. rules[] are rule-derived from E1 hazard flags (so any machine, incl. user-invented, gets sensible relationships); pairs[] are explicit type-pair defaults (SLP workflow chains). Precedence: user override > explicit pair > rule-derived > NEUTRAL. Conflicting rules: most-severe level wins, most-conservative (max) required separation. EVERY entry carries provenance: a standard clause or the literal 'design assumption'. See v2/ADJACENCY.md.
